queries: SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_remaining, COUNT(*) AS budget_line_count FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent > 6.0 GROUP BY e.status;

assumptions.assumption: Statuses appear only when they have at least one qualifying budget line; AVG returns NULL when all differences in a group are missing.

alternatives.interpretation: Show every status present in the event table, including statuses with no qualifying budget lines.
alternatives.sql: SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_remaining, COUNT(b.budget_id) AS budget_line_count FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event AND b.spent > 6.0 GROUP BY e.status;
